description:
Epiphany puts your markets, your money and your city on one screen.

Markets: stocks, crypto and commodities with clear charts and the news behind each move.
Portfolio: net worth, holdings, budget, debt payoff and goals, synced from your brokerage if you want.
Situation: a live map of what is happening near you, from earthquakes and wildfires to traffic and flights overhead.

Brokerage links are read-only by default. Nothing is traded unless you turn trading on.
whatsNew: Stocks open full screen on a live chart with candles, volume bars and VWAP. Drag across the chart and the price, change and date follow your finger, and the change line matches the range you pick. Anthropic (ANT) is in the default watchlist. Business News no longer spins forever and pulls from more than one source. Fear and Greed reads right in a hard selloff. New avatars, a cleaner portfolio header, and Appearance sits at the bottom of Settings. In the US you can get Epiphany Pro from Settings.
